posts.title: How to Download YouTube Videos in 4K (2026 Guide)
posts.excerpt: A step-by-step walkthrough for saving YouTube videos in crisp 4K.
posts.author: The SavDown Team
posts.content:
YouTube hosts some of the highest-quality video on the web.

## What you need
- A public YouTube video in 4K.
- The video URL.
- SavDown open in your browser.

## Step by step
- Copy the video URL from YouTube.
- Paste it into the SavDown YouTube Video Downloader.
- Choose **MP4 4K** and download.

## A note on quality
SavDown streams the original without re-encoding — no watermark, no quality loss.

posts.title: Is It Legal to Download Videos From Social Media?
posts.excerpt: The honest answer is it depends. A clear breakdown of when downloading is fine.
posts.author: The SavDown Team
posts.content:
Whether downloading is lawful depends on **what** you download and **what you do with it**.

## When it is fine
- Content you own.
- Creative Commons or public domain content.
- Fair use for education or research.

## When it is not okay
- Re-uploading as your own.
- Selling content you do not own.
- Bypassing DRM protection.

posts.title: MP4 vs MP3 vs GIF: Which Format Should You Choose?
posts.excerpt: Video, audio, or a looping clip? A quick guide to picking the right format.
posts.author: The SavDown Team
posts.content:
## MP4: the everyday video
MP4 is the universal format. Choose by resolution:
- **4K / 1080p** for big screens.
- **720p** for quick sharing.

## MP3: audio only
**MP3** strips the video and keeps audio — perfect for podcasts.

## Quick cheat sheet
- Watch later → **MP4**
- Listen only → **MP3**
- Short loop → **GIF**

posts.title: How to Save TikTok Videos Without the Watermark
posts.excerpt: How to save TikToks in HD without the bouncing logo.
posts.author: The SavDown Team
posts.content:
## How to remove the watermark
- Tap **Share → Copy Link** on the TikTok.
- Paste into the SavDown TikTok Downloader.
- Choose **MP4 HD (no watermark)**.

## Please credit creators
Removing a watermark does not remove creator rights. Tag the original if you repost.

posts.title: A Creator's Guide to Repurposing Video Content
posts.excerpt: One video can become a dozen posts across every platform.
posts.author: The SavDown Team
posts.content:
The most efficient creators make their content go further.

## Start with a source
Save your original in the best resolution available.

## Slice it into moments
Each strong moment can become:
- A vertical short for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts.
- A square clip for the feed.

## Work smart, credit fairly
Repurpose your own work freely. Credit others when you build on their content.
